dispatch: Session 171 closed its interrupted run cleanly: three audit items sealed, 108 HTML files crawled without a single failure, and six desktop-and-mobile screenshots of Vorn, Privacy, and the community journal now verified green and wired into build:check. The RUM diagnostics gate no longer stays silent — it writes its own next action to `.cache/rum-export-diagnostics.json` so the forge surfaces dormant loops instead of burying them. Runway truth is current; the vault holds.
